# Resonant Web Design

Resonant Web Design is a selective custom web design and development studio led by Richard B. Jamison. National clientele; Ohio roots.

## What We Do

- Custom web development built around how a business actually runs
- SEO foundations and content architecture that ship with the site
- System integrations, APIs, automation, and AI phone/chat workflows
- Hosting, maintenance, and launch systems
- Insights on website strategy, SEO, local search, and connected systems
- Industry depth: landscaping, restaurants/hospitality, roofing, service businesses

## Positioning

- National custom work (not limited to one metro)
- Fewer clients at a time; deeply custom
- SEO handled in-house
- No template assembly line
- Operator-led strategy for real service businesses
